mapper.select: SELECT t.type_id AS typeId, t.team_id AS teamId, t.project_id AS projectId, t.type_name AS typeName, t.sort_order AS sortOrder, t.enabled AS enabled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_case c INNER JOIN sys_project p ON c.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id AND c.case_type = t.type_id) AS caseCount FROM sys_case_type t WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.type_id

SELECT type_id AS typeId, team_id AS teamId, project_id AS projectId, type_name AS typeName, sort_order AS sortOrder, enabled AS enabled FROM sys_case_type WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND type_name = #{typeName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_case_type (team_id, type_name, sort_order, enabled) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{typeName}, #{sortOrder}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_case_type SET type_name = #{typeName} WHERE type_id = #{typeId} AND team_id = #{teamId}
UPDATE sys_case_type SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE type_id = #{typeId} AND team_id = #{teamId}
